description.zh: 目的端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The destination IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

description.zh:
授权方向。
- egress：出方向。
- ingress：入方向。
description.en:
The direction in which the security group rule is applied.

- egress

- ingress

description.zh:
协议类型。取值范围： 
         
- TCP：TCP协议。
- UDP：UDP协议。
- ICMP：ICMP协议。
- ICMPv6：IPv6 ICMP协议。
- ALL：支持所有协议。
description.en:
Protocol type. Valid values:

- TCP

- UDP

- ICMP: the ICMP protocol

- ICMPv6: the IPv6 ICMP protocol.

- ALL: All protocols are supported.

description.zh:
目的端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。 

> 该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。
description.en:
The destination IPv6 CIDR block. IPv6 CIDR blocks and IPv6 addresses are supported.

> This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be set at the same time.

description.zh:
源端IPv6 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv6格式的IP地址范围。
> 该参数与`DestCidrIp`参数不可同时设置。
description.en:
The source IPv6 CIDR block of the security group rule. IPv6 CIDR blocks and IPv6 addresses are supported.

> This parameter and the `DestCidrIp` parameter cannot be set at the same time.

description.zh:
访问权限。取值范围： 
         
- Accept：接受访问。
- Drop：拒绝访问。
description.en:
The action specified in the security group rule. Valid values:

- Accept

- Drop

description.zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的目的端口范围。取值范围：
         
- TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
- ICMP协议：-1/-1。
- ALL：-1/-1。
description.en:
The destination port range of the security group rule. Valid values:

- If you set IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the valid values of this parameter are 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<Start port number>/\<End port number>. Example: 1/200.

- If you set IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If you set IpProtocol to ALL, the port number range is -1/-1.

description.zh: 安全组规则优先级，数字越小，代表优先级越高。取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The priority of the security group rule. A smaller value specifies a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 源端IPv4 CIDR地址段。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。
description.en: The source IPv4 CIDR block. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

description.zh:
安全组开放的各协议相关的源端口范围。取值范围：
         
- TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200
- ICMP协议：-1/-1。
- ALL：-1/-1。
description.en:
The range of source port numbers for the protocols specified in the security group rule. Valid values:

- If you set IpProtocol to TCP or UDP, the valid values of this parameter are 1 to 65535. Specify a port range in the format of \<Start port number>/\<End port number>. Example: 1/200.

- If you set IpProtocol to ICMP, the port range is -1/-1.

- If you set IpProtocol to ALL, the port range is -1/-1.
The ID of the security group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ens delete-security-group-permissions --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --permissions Policy=Accept PortRange=80/80 SourcePortRange=22/22 Priority=1 SourceCidrIp=0.XX.XX.0/0 IpProtocol=TCP DestCidrIp=10.XX.XX.91 Ipv6SourceCidrIp=::/0 Ipv6DestCidrIp=::/0 Direction=ingress --region cn-hangzhou
